meta.name: Living Infrastructure
meta.description: A continuous scroll-driven developer portfolio where one root node unfolds into backend topology and project architecture.

primary.role: global canvas and deepest infrastructure plane

secondary.role: raised system surfaces and focused topology regions

accent.role: active request, selected node, focus indicator, and primary action

neutral.usage: Light values carry primary copy, middle values carry secondary copy and inactive topology, dark values define depth planes.

color.contrast_strategy: High-contrast light ink on graphite with one signal-orange functional accent; no full-frame overlays or neon glow.

typography.font_style_notes: Geometric-humanist sans for confident clarity; mono is limited to technical labels and verified system data.

spacing.content_density: spacious around copy, dense inside the topology
spacing.section_rhythm: One continuous world with calm opening, increasing system density, a stable reading interval, and a larger Projects peak.

layout.grid_system: Asymmetric viewport composition over a fixed stage with semantic copy windows
layout.max_content_width: 1600px for the visual stage; 62ch for prose
layout.columns: 12-column alignment scaffold used invisibly, not as a repeated landing-page layout
layout.alignment_tendency: Asymmetric with controlled radial topology moments

shape.border_usage: Fine one-pixel structural lines for topology and focus, not card decoration
shape.divider_style: Topology paths and negative space replace generic section dividers

elevation.shadow_style: Tinted, offset, and restrained with edge-light support
elevation.depth_cues: Overlap, scale, contrast falloff, light blur, occlusion, and differential movement

iconography.style: Technical monoline where an icon is genuinely needed

motion.easing: Scroll-linked linear progress for scrubbed world motion; cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1) for UI responses
motion.entrance_pattern: Existing geometry reorganizes or reveals through masks; no repeated fade-up pattern
motion.exit_pattern: Geometry becomes the next state instead of fading to an empty frame
motion.philosophy: Cinematic but causal: motion communicates system structure, state, and navigation

components.button_style: Compact high-contrast text actions with directional underline and subtle press scale
components.input_style: Dark structural surface, visible label, orange focus ring, no glass treatment
components.card_style: No generic cards; project surfaces grow from topology nodes
components.navigation_pattern: Compact waypoint map tied to the persistent request trace
components.modal_style: No project modal; selected node morphs into the project surface
components.list_style: Spatial system grouping and semantic layers instead of badge clouds or divided rows
components.component_notes: All interactive states include hover, focus-visible, active, disabled, touch, and reduced-motion behavior.

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: A living backend system observed from root node to project architecture
aesthetic.era_influence: Contemporary computational design with patent-drawing and infrastructure-map discipline

visual_language.whitespace_usage: Large quiet fields around concentrated topology
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: A single root focus expands into distributed density, then reconverges
visual_language.focal_strategy: Progressive reveal with one project-transformation peak
visual_language.texture_usage: Subtle fixed grain and controlled atmospheric depth only

composition.hierarchy_method: Scale, spatial isolation, connection density, and signal color
composition.balance_type: Asymmetric with temporary radial balance around the root node
composition.flow_direction: Depth-first, then distributed lateral topology, then focused project expansion
composition.grouping_strategy: Connection, proximity, and shared system boundary
composition.negative_space_role: Provides silence before dense transformations and preserves copy readability

imagery.photo_treatment: No photography in the first prototype; later assets must remain industrial and documentary rather than stock-tech
imagery.illustration_style: Precise SVG topology and exploded technical-system drawing
imagery.graphic_elements: Nodes, routes, boundary surfaces, request pulses, and coordinate anchors
imagery.pattern_usage: No decorative repeating pattern; repetition only represents real system structure
imagery.image_shape: Viewport-scale topology fields and expanding project surfaces

interaction_feel.hover_behavior: Local focus redirects connected routes and reduces unrelated system weight
interaction_feel.loading_style: Complete static opening composition before motion enhancement
interaction_feel.microinteraction_density: Low outside projects, moderate inside focus states

brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: Plain explanation with one available next action
brand_voice_in_ui.error_tone: Specific cause, impact, and recovery action

overview.fallback_strategy: Static SVG composition and normal document flow with short opacity transitions
overview.primary_technology: GSAP ScrollTrigger plus SVG and CSS transforms

background_effects.description: Graphite depth planes with restrained grain and slow contrast shifts

particle_systems.description: Particles are intentionally excluded; nodes and routes carry meaning.

3d_elements.description: Depth is produced through SVG planes, scale, blur, overlap, and perspective transforms.

shader_effects.description: No shader is required for the prototype.

parallax.speed_curve: small differential rates with GSAP scrub

scroll_triggered_animations.trigger_points: One normalized master track with labeled waypoints
scroll_triggered_animations.animation_type: scale, route draw, clip reveal, topology rearrangement, copy-window reveal
scroll_triggered_animations.scrub_behavior: Reversible 1:1 target progress with light smoothing

scroll_morphing.description: Root node becomes topology, About surface, and project modules without clearing the stage.

text_effects.type: line mask, scale, and tracking transform
text_effects.description: Hero identity compresses as the system opens; short copy reveals by line.

cursor_effects.type: context label and local magnetic response
cursor_effects.description: Native cursor remains; a small project-context label and fine-pointer depth response appear only in project zones.

params.shape: native pointer plus compact text label
params.interaction_zone: project nodes and primary action only

image_effects.description: The prototype uses SVG primitives rather than raster imagery.

canvas_drawings.description: SVG remains sufficient and more accessible for the prototype.

svg_animations.description: Routes draw, nodes reorganize, boundaries expand, and the request trace travels through persistent geometry.

params.path_morphing: limited to compatible path pairs and group transforms

visual_effects.composite_notes: The experience uses one fixed SVG world and one semantic copy layer. Scroll controls a reversible master timeline. The peak is the topology-to-project transformation. Effects are reduced on mobile and replaced with normal-flow content under reduced motion.
